observations: Photo 0 shows the top panel of a white projector with the brand 'EPSON' clearly visible.
The model 'EB-X12' is printed on a button below the control pad in photo 0.
The control panel includes buttons for Menu, Source Search, Enter, Volume, Help, Esc, and Lamp Temp.
A warning label is visible on the top panel, with multilingual text about lamp safety.
Photo 1 shows the front of the same projector, with the lens, ventilation grille, and 'EPSON' branding on the front bezel.
The front also shows a '3LCD' logo, indicating the projection technology.
Both photos show a watermark 'PROJECTOR CENTER POSTED ON JIJI', suggesting the listing source.
No visible damage or wear is apparent in either photo.

claims.claim: The epson europe eb-x12 projector is a xga conference room projector.
claims.evidence: The model EB-X12 is confirmed in photo 0, but the 'XGA' resolution and 'conference room' use are not visible in the photos. These are typical specs for the model, but not proven by the images.
Photo 0 shows a 'Lamp Temp' button and a warning label about lamp handling, indicating it is a lamp-based projector.
